name: emacs-operator
description: Operate GNU Emacs from an MCP agent through semantic RPC, Emacs-internal keymaps, and guarded native desktop interaction.
long_description: Emacs Operator exposes GNU Emacs as a stateful agent runtime. The MCP server discovers a local Emacs bridge, opens explicit sessions, observes buffer and mode state, performs transactional edits, executes active Emacs keymaps, and can use a separately installed native Host for real desktop input and selected-window capture. macOS uses Accessibility, CGEvent, and ScreenCaptureKit. Linux Alpha.13 uses an X11/XTest Host and reports Wayland/uinput limitations explicitly. The bundle contains companion Elisp and Agent Skill resources, while native Hosts remain explicit platform installations.
